title: B Academics Teaching Roundtable 2026 — Eric's keynote brought the network one of its biggest audiences ever
summary: B Academics, the global network of educators and researchers studying B Lab, B Corp certification and benefit corporations, held its fifth annual Teaching Roundtable online on Friday 23 October, and says it was its highest attended to date. Eric gave the featured keynote, alongside mini keynotes from LIFT Economy's Ryan Honeyman and B Lab's Erik Kivimaki.
blockquote: Our featured keynote speaker, Eric Ries, blew our audience away with a candid discussion on what it takes for an organization #ForGood to become truly #Incorruptible, bringing together one of B Academics’ biggest audiences ever.
